title: Aftermath: Monty Kaye hears the whipping, and Billie sings that night
summary: Monty Kaye barges in; Billie sings perfectly despite her welts.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Yeah. So he heard this rumbling next door so he came in, knocked, open the door and came in. I gave him a swish of the thing, talking about, talk about troops withdrawing, he slammed the door and got out of there (laughter). And Jess Price is witnessing all of this. He's just rolling on the floor, on the couch, everywhere, in the chair. He's getting out of our way (laughter).

So that night I left and went to work and I told Mike Osserman that she work for I say, "She won't be to work tonight," but before I left home I run a bathtub full of cold water with a box of table salt in it and put her in it to close up the welts, you know. So I just knew she wasn't going to be at work.

I took intermission. Went across the street. There she is under this pin light with this gardenia in her hair, singing her ass off. (Laughter). Never phased her. I say Jesus Christ. And she could drink and partake of pills, smoke grass and shoot heroin more than any ten men and still maneuver. Many a night I'd look for her to get out on the floor and not be able to open her mouth. Sing her ass off.
